topic: Customer Master (SD/FI) — learned from the Customer Creation SOP
source: Customer_Creation_01_16.011 (Keynote) analysed by Deck Insight AI

structure.General Data: Name, address, communication (mobile & email). Shared across all company codes / sales areas. Table KNA1.
structure.Control Data: Tax/registration numbers. In this org: GST Number in Tax Number 3, Drug License Number in Tax Number 5.

Sales Area Data.Sales: Sales District, Sales Office, Sales Group, Customer Group, Currency.
Sales Area Data.Shipping: Delivery Priority, Shipping Conditions, Delivering Plant.
Sales Area Data.Billing: Incoterms = NA, Payment Terms, Acct. Assignment Group; GST code 0 if registered, 1 if not.
Sales Area Data.Partner Functions: Sales Person. Standard partner functions: AG=Sold-to, WE=Ship-to, RE=Bill-to, RG=Payer.

structure.Extras / Customer Group 4: Z01 = Sold-to Customer, Z02 = Ship-to Customer.

complianceNotes: GST code inversion (0 vs 1) is the highest-risk field; it drives tax treatment.
GST goes in Tax Number 3 and Drug License in Tax Number 5 — non-obvious fields, regulated for a drug distributor.
Reconciliation Account 11000000 is fixed and must not be changed.
Sold-to (Z01) vs Ship-to (Z02) must match the real commercial relationship.
howToView: Enter XD03 → key in Customer number, Company Code 2100, Sales Org Z210 → review the same views (General, Control, Company Code, Sales Area, Partner Functions) in read-only mode. In S/4HANA use BP, role Customer, Display mode.
